import json, openpyxl
p='inputs/sources/fil_01M6K555XRRE2TT62NBMFAD964.xlsx'
wbf=openpyxl.load_workbook(p, data_only=False)
wbv=openpyxl.load_workbook(p, data_only=True)
for name in wbf.sheetnames:
    wf=wbf[name]; wv=wbv[name]
    print('SHEET', name, wf.max_row, wf.max_column)
    for r in range(1, min(wf.max_row,3)+1):
        out=[]
        for c in range(1, wf.max_column+1):
            cf=wf.cell(r,c); cv=wv.cell(r,c)
            if cf.data_type=='f':
                out.append((cf.coordinate, 'F:'+str(cf.value), 'v='+str(cv.value)))
            else:
                out.append((cf.coordinate, repr(cf.value)))
        print(' row', r, out)
print('names', list(getattr(wbf,'defined_names',{}) or {}))
print('comments', [(ws.title, c.coordinate, c.comment.text[:80]) for ws in wbf.worksheets for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if c.comment][:10])
